scope: Source-linked body-Results sentence patterns and paper-level narrative logic from all currently included Clinical Cancer Research issue-year 2025-2026 articles in the installed library; excluded narrative/commentary records are omitted.

project_scope.source_scope: Actual supplied main PDFs: body Results reread for every paper, with Abstract/Discussion endpoint hierarchy and Methods context checked as needed; selected source pages and central result/figure/table pages visually inspected. Separate or unprovided supplements are not implied.

papers.title: Metabolic Tumor Volume Assessed by 18F FDG-PET CT Scan as a Predictive Biomarker for Immune Checkpoint Blockers in Advanced NSCLC and Its Biological Correlates
central_results: High total metabolic tumor volume was independently associated with shorter survival, whereas exploratory microbiome differences disappeared after multiplicity correction.
narrative_sequence: Define the imaging burden, relate it to survival, then explore immune and microbial correlates and close with an FDR-sensitive null.
papers.negative_result_handling: The paper explicitly distinguishes nominal species-level differences from the absence of FDR-adjusted significance.
papers.omics_logic: Bulk immune deconvolution and stool microbiome analyses are correlational; inferred cell proportions are not direct cell counts.
papers.efficacy_logic: Treatment comparisons are observational within an ICI-treated cohort and do not establish predictive interaction.
papers.prognosis_logic: tMTV is treated as a prognostic association after multivariable adjustment, not as a validated treatment-selection marker.
claim_boundaries: Retrospective single-cohort associations remain vulnerable to confounding
nominal microbiome signals do not survive multiplicity correction.

papers.title: Phase I Study of ROR1-Specific CAR-T Cells in Advanced Hematopoietic and Epithelial Malignancies
central_results: ROR1 CAR-T cells showed limited solid-tumor activity, transient regressions, and clinically important pulmonary toxicity in a first-in-human study.
narrative_sequence: Begin with dose delivery and toxicity, then describe expansion, trafficking and antitumor activity, ending with durability limits.
papers.negative_result_handling: Stable disease and early regression are bounded by progression before six months; toxicity and activity are reported together when clinically linked.
papers.omics_logic: Correlative trafficking and anti-CAR immune measurements support biological activity but not tumor-cell killing in all lesions.
papers.efficacy_logic: Single-arm phase I activity is descriptive and cannot establish comparative efficacy.
papers.prognosis_logic: Survival was not the central inferential endpoint.
claim_boundaries: Very small heterogeneous cohorts and dose-level changes preclude causal or comparative claims.

papers.title: Phase I/II Investigator-Initiated Study of Olaparib and Temozolomide in SCLC: Final Analysis and CNS Outcomes
central_results: Combination olaparib and temozolomide had limited overall activity that halted expansion, alongside an exploratory intracranial disease-control signal.
narrative_sequence: Report the halted expansion and overall activity first, then characterize dose/schedule and the selected CNS subgroup.
papers.negative_result_handling: Negative overall activity is stated directly; the CNS signal is kept exploratory and separated from the stopped expansion.
papers.omics_logic: No omics layer was central to the selected result logic.
papers.efficacy_logic: Intracranial response is a selected subgroup result in a nonrandomized early-phase trial.
papers.prognosis_logic: Time-to-event outcomes are descriptive and not used to claim prognosis.
claim_boundaries: The CNS subgroup excludes previously irradiated target lesions but remains small and lacks a comparator.

papers.title: YAP Regulates HER3 Signaling-Driven Adaptive Resistance to RET Inhibitors in RET-Aberrant Cancers
central_results: 高YAP的RET异常模型出现HER3相关适应性耐药，pan-ERBB联合可在部分模型恢复RET-TKI敏感性，但敏感细胞系未见额外增殖抑制。
narrative_sequence: 先界定YAP/HER3状态与耐药表型，再做遗传/药理干预，最后以跨模型例外限定联合策略。
papers.negative_result_handling: 把敏感细胞系的阴性组合结果作为模型依赖性边界，而非笼统否定。
papers.omics_logic: 细胞系表达与信号层结果用于分层机制，不外推为患者肿瘤直接证据。
papers.efficacy_logic: 仅有临床队列探索信息，核心疗效证据为前临床。
papers.prognosis_logic: 无可确证的临床预后结论。
claim_boundaries: 前临床模型、药物剂量和YAP高表达背景限定；不得宣称临床协同。

papers.title: Aberrant Activation of Wound-Healing Programs within the Metastatic Niche Facilitates Lung Colonization by Osteosarcoma Cells
central_results: 单细胞分析显示肺转移灶富集Trem2/Cd9/Spp1巨噬细胞，抗纤维化药在免疫完整和缺陷模型均抑制转移进展。
narrative_sequence: 由转移生态图谱到候选伤口愈合程序，再以药理干预验证可操作性。
papers.negative_result_handling: 未把未涉及的临床生存或自发转移终点硬补为阴性。
papers.omics_logic: 单细胞簇用于描述小鼠转移微环境，不等同人类直接测量。
papers.efficacy_logic: 疗效只在动物实验性肺定植模型中成立。
papers.prognosis_logic: 未报告人类预后。
claim_boundaries: 尾静脉定植模型不是自发转移模型，不能外推患者获益。

papers.title: Divergent Clinical and Immunologic Outcomes Based on STK11 Co-mutation Status in Resectable KRAS-Mutant Lung Cancers Following Neoadjuvant Immune Checkpoint Blockade
central_results: STK11状态与MPR无显著差异，但KRAS突变亚队列中STK11共突变与更高复发风险相关。
narrative_sequence: 先报告病理反应阴性，再转向复发结局阳性，形成终点分层而非单一结论。
papers.negative_result_handling: 明确有限样本与P=1.0；不把无显著MPR差异解释为等效。
papers.omics_logic: 免疫分析支持生物背景，但不把组织相关性升级为治疗预测。
papers.efficacy_logic: MPR分析限手术切除者。
papers.prognosis_logic: 复发关联CI很宽，仅属治疗后队列中的预后性信号。
claim_boundaries: 不得把复发风险关联写成STK11对新辅助ICB的预测性治疗交互。

papers.title: Analysis of Shared Variants between Cancer Biospecimens
central_results: A shared-variant molecular probability score accurately distinguished same-origin from distinct cancers and prompted diagnosis or treatment changes in selected discordant cases.
narrative_sequence: Derive the score, validate discrimination, review discordant cases, then describe clinical reassignment and plasma extensions.
papers.negative_result_handling: Discordance is adjudicated rather than relabeled as assay failure; selected case review is kept distinct from cohort-wide performance.
papers.omics_logic: The genomic score uses shared variants and relatedness features; it is a classifier, not direct proof of clonal origin in every case.
papers.efficacy_logic: Treatment changes after review are process outcomes, not evidence that the changes improved efficacy.
papers.prognosis_logic: Prognosis was not a central endpoint.
claim_boundaries: Clinical diagnosis is an imperfect reference, and the 80 discordant cases were a selected subset.

papers.title: Safety and Tolerability of Letetresgene Autoleucel (GSK3377794): Pilot Studies in Patients with Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
central_results: In the single-arm study, one of the five patients (ORR 20%
95% CI, 0.5–71.6) had a confirmed partial response (PR) following the first T-cell infusion.
In the multiarm study, six (86%) and two (33%) patients had stable disease as best response in arms A and C, respectively, and no patients had a PR or complete response (Fig. 2A and B).
narrative_sequence: 先报告单臂研究中的个体客观缓解，再对另一研究臂的疾病稳定与无缓解进行并列呈现。
papers.negative_result_handling: 所选代表句无正式阴性结果；未把缺少检验的信息补写成不显著。
papers.omics_logic: 组学不是本文所选核心结果；未额外制造组学结论。
papers.efficacy_logic: 疗效/活性语句严格服从两项小型早期研究、样本极少且置信区间很宽；只能表述临床活性，不能进行比较疗效推断。；保留分析集、终点层级、是否有对照及统计状态。
papers.prognosis_logic: 未将非生存结果改写为预后结论。
claim_boundaries: 两项小型早期研究、样本极少且置信区间很宽；只能表述临床活性，不能进行比较疗效推断。
极小样本单臂活性；置信区间必须保留。
描述性多臂结果，无正式组间效应检验。

papers.title: Noninvasive Multicancer Detection Using DNA Hypomethylation of LINE-1 Retrotransposons
central_results: 部分癌种/分期的全局甲基化未见差异，而基于LINE-1甲基化的分类器在验证中显示较高AUC但固定特异度下灵敏度差异大。
narrative_sequence: 从生物信号分布进入特征选择和模型验证，再以特异度-灵敏度权衡限定应用。
papers.negative_result_handling: 保留癌种/分期特异的阴性结果，不概括为所有癌症均无甲基化差异。
papers.omics_logic: 甲基化特征用于分类建模。
papers.efficacy_logic: 无治疗疗效分析。
papers.prognosis_logic: 无预后推断。
claim_boundaries: 病例-对照/富集设计不支持人群筛查PPV或临床效用。

papers.title: Phase I/II Trial of Exportin 1 Inhibitor Selinexor plus Docetaxel in Previously Treated, Advanced KRAS-Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
central_results: KRAS突变亚型间影像反应无显著差异，TP53改变则与更短PFS相关。
narrative_sequence: 先给总体活性，再逐层考察基因亚组，区分无效应证据与预后性关联。
papers.negative_result_handling: KRAS亚型P=0.30仅表示未检出差异。
papers.omics_logic: 面板变异用于探索分层，不等同全基因组机制。
papers.efficacy_logic: 单臂研究不能得出比较疗效。
papers.prognosis_logic: TP53–PFS属于治疗队列内预后关联，不是治疗特异预测。
claim_boundaries: 样本小且无对照治疗交互。

papers.title: Longitudinal Blood Immune-Inflammatory and Radiomic Profiling to Decode Different Patterns of Acquired Resistance to Immunotherapy in Patients with NSCLC
central_results: Systemic acquired resistance was associated with distinct inflammatory features and markedly shorter post-progression survival than oligoprogression.
narrative_sequence: Compare baseline immune features, connect resistance pattern to post-progression survival, then add longitudinal and radiomic correlates.
papers.negative_result_handling: Mostly null baseline immune comparisons are preserved with explicit exceptions and trends.
papers.omics_logic: Blood immune cells, cytokines and radiomics are separate modalities; radiomic analyses involve a particularly small subset.
papers.efficacy_logic: Resistance-pattern comparisons are observational and do not prove that local treatment causes longer survival.
papers.prognosis_logic: Post-progression survival differences are prognostic associations between resistance phenotypes.
claim_boundaries: Small radiomic and subgroup samples, treatment heterogeneity and post-progression selection limit inference.

papers.title: Smoking-Associated Carcinogen-Induced Inflammation Promotes Lung Carcinogenesis via IRAK4 Activation
central_results: Myosin heavy chain 9 protein (MYH9) was dephosphorylated significantly at serine 1943 residue in both cell lines upon IRAK4 inhibition.
Both IRAK4 knockout cell lines demonstrated significant reduction in Matrigel invasion in vitro.
narrative_sequence: 由磷酸化改变推进到侵袭表型，形成分子靶点—功能读出的机制链。
papers.negative_result_handling: 所选代表句无正式阴性结果；未把缺少检验的信息补写成不显著。
papers.omics_logic: 组学叙述限定于protein证据层，并按测量/推断边界表述；不把计算丰度、共现或跨层相关写成直接细胞测量或因果。
papers.efficacy_logic: 疗效不是本文所选核心结果；未从生物标志物或模型结果推导临床获益。
papers.prognosis_logic: 未将非生存结果改写为预后结论。
claim_boundaries: 证据限于细胞和动物前临床模型，不得外推为患者获益。
蛋白磷酸化读出来自细胞系。
体外侵袭实验不能替代临床转移结局。

papers.title: Phase II Open-Label Trial of Brentuximab Vedotin with Pembrolizumab in PD-1-Pretreated Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and Metastatic Cutaneous Melanoma
central_results: 难治性NSCLC队列观察到14% ORR和72% DCR，但不同PD-L1层级的ORR、DCR、PFS和OS均无显著差异。
narrative_sequence: 先定量单臂活性，再用标志物亚组阴性结果限制选择性解释。
papers.negative_result_handling: PD-L1阴性比较不被写成标志物无用或等效。
papers.omics_logic: IHC仅作探索性分层。
papers.efficacy_logic: 仅支持单臂临床活性。
papers.prognosis_logic: 未建立独立预后效应。
claim_boundaries: 不能称为恢复免疫治疗敏感性或优于标准治疗。

papers.title: Impact of Co-mutations and Transcriptional Signatures in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Patients Treated with Adagrasib in the KRYSTAL-1 Trial
central_results: KEAP1或STK11共突变与较差PFS/OS相关；ORR中KEAP1仅数值降低，STK11两组相同。
narrative_sequence: 从生存强信号到反应终点的阴性/趋势差异，强调结局不一致。
papers.negative_result_handling: 把KEAP1 P=0.07与STK11 P=1.00分开，不把趋势升级。
papers.omics_logic: 共突变来自肿瘤基因组分层。
papers.efficacy_logic: adagrasib单队列反应比较不能证明治疗交互。
papers.prognosis_logic: 生存结果为治疗队列内预后关联。
claim_boundaries: 不得称共突变为已验证耐药预测标志物。

papers.title: Tremelimumab plus Durvalumab prior to Chemoradiotherapy in Unresectable, Locally Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: The Induction Trial
central_results: 低剂量tremelimumab队列按预设标准安全，高剂量队列不安全；部分N2/N3患者观察到纵隔降期。
narrative_sequence: 先以安全性决定剂量可行性，再报告探索性临床活动。
papers.negative_result_handling: 高剂量毒性是研究主导结果，不被降期信号掩盖。
papers.omics_logic: 无核心组学推断。
papers.efficacy_logic: 降期为小样本探索性活性。
papers.prognosis_logic: 未成熟到预后判断。
claim_boundaries: 剂量队列很小，不能推广到其他方案或长期获益。

papers.title: MAPK Pathway-Activating Alteration and Immunotherapy Efficacy in Squamous Cell Lung Carcinoma: Results from the Randomized, Prospective SQUINT Trial
central_results: Patients positive for mutation and/or CNV in MAPK1/MAPK3 signaling pathway genes had significantly longer OS [16.3 months (95% CI, 13.5–30.6) vs. 10.7 months (95% CI, 6.1–13.3)
P = 0.03] than individuals without any MAPK1/MAPK3 mutation or CNV (Fig. 3).

As illustrated in Supplementary Fig. S13, there was no difference in the median OS between patients with versus without MAPK1/MAPK3 alterations, supporting the predictive rather than simply prognostic role of such molecular events [HR = 0.74 (95% CI, 0.43–1.27)
narrative_sequence: 先报告分子改变与免疫治疗后生存的阳性关联，再用未接受相关治疗的外部队列检验其是否只是一般预后标志。
papers.negative_result_handling: 明确保留1条阴性或不确定结果的原始推断状态；未显著、未报告检验和不可判定分别编码，未将其合并为“无效”。
papers.omics_logic: 组学叙述限定于integrated、genomic证据层，并按测量/推断边界表述；不把计算丰度、共现或跨层相关写成直接细胞测量或因果。
papers.efficacy_logic: 疗效不是本文所选核心结果；未从生物标志物或模型结果推导临床获益。
papers.prognosis_logic: 时间结局仅按原设计表述为预后/结局关联；若无正式交互，不升级为治疗预测。
claim_boundaries: 作者提出预测性解释，但未提供正式治疗交互检验；不得写成已验证的疗效预测标志物。
治疗背景内分子亚组关联；不等于正式治疗交互。
对照队列阴性支持作者的预测性解释，但没有正式交互检验。

papers.title: In Situ RAS:RAF Binding Correlates with Response to KRASG12C Inhibitors in KRASG12C-Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
central_results: In situ RAS–RAF binding correlated with KRASG12C-inhibitor disease control and PFS, whereas an alternative EGFR–GRB2 PLA readout did not.
narrative_sequence: Validate the PLA assay, establish mechanistic models, connect the candidate readout to treated cases, then use an orthogonal null as specificity evidence.
papers.negative_result_handling: The null EGFR–GRB2 association is used as a contrast rather than being hidden.
papers.omics_logic: PLA measures protein proximity in fixed tissue; it is not equivalent to pathway flux or direct kinase activity.
papers.efficacy_logic: Clinical associations lack a randomized biomarker-treatment interaction test.
papers.prognosis_logic: PFS associations are treatment-cohort prognostic/response associations rather than validated prediction.
claim_boundaries: Small retrospective treated cohorts and assay-specific thresholds constrain generalization.

papers.title: Pretargeted Trop-2 ImmunoPET for Rapid, Selective Detection of Pancreatic Tumors
central_results: 在已测试构建体中，[64Cu]Cu-Sar-Tz/TCO-Lys-Trop-2.2表现最佳；可裂解构型反而在关键时间点肿瘤靶向较差。
narrative_sequence: 通过构建体筛选、体内分布和失败构型形成设计迭代逻辑。
papers.negative_result_handling: 未报告统计时仅称inferior，不补写显著性。
papers.omics_logic: 分子成像与体内分布是前临床功能层证据。
papers.efficacy_logic: 不涉及治疗疗效。
papers.prognosis_logic: 不涉及预后。
claim_boundaries: ‘best’只限所测试构建体；肿瘤摄取不等于临床诊断性能。

papers.title: Follow-up Analysis Enhances Understanding of Molecular Residual Disease in Localized Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
central_results: Longitudinal undetectable MRD strongly associated with longer DFS, while a matched observational comparison did not show a significant adjuvant-therapy survival difference.
narrative_sequence: Define longitudinal MRD states, connect them to recurrence and DFS, then test whether adjuvant therapy altered outcomes in selected groups.
papers.negative_result_handling: The nonsignificant adjuvant comparison is reported with its wide confidence interval and is not called equivalence.
papers.omics_logic: Personalized ctDNA detection is a genomic surrogate of residual disease and may miss isolated brain relapse.
papers.efficacy_logic: Propensity matching reduces measured imbalance but does not create randomized treatment evidence.
papers.prognosis_logic: MRD status is prognostic; treatment benefit is not established from the null observational comparison.
claim_boundaries: Same-cohort derivation, limited events and site-specific shedding affect transportability.

papers.title: Targeting AXL Inhibits the Growth and Metastasis of Prostate Cancer in Bone
central_results: Both univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses (Fig. 1F) showed that high p-AXL protein expression was significantly associated with survival outcome.
However, combination therapy compared to batiraxcept alone did not show statistically significant differences in suppression of tumor growth based on bioluminescence imaging (Fig. 4A and B).
narrative_sequence: 患者样本的蛋白表达—结局关联之后，转入药物干预实验并报告联合治疗未显著优于单药。
papers.negative_result_handling: 明确保留1条阴性或不确定结果的原始推断状态；未显著、未报告检验和不可判定分别编码，未将其合并为“无效”。
papers.omics_logic: 组学叙述限定于protein证据层，并按测量/推断边界表述；不把计算丰度、共现或跨层相关写成直接细胞测量或因果。
papers.efficacy_logic: 疗效不是本文所选核心结果；未从生物标志物或模型结果推导临床获益。
papers.prognosis_logic: 未将非生存结果改写为预后结论。
claim_boundaries: 临床相关性与前临床干预证据层不同，不能拼接成临床因果结论。
组织蛋白表达与结局相关，不证明因果。
前临床阴性比较不能写成等效。

papers.title: Round-Robin Comparison of RET Rearrangement Detection in ctDNA: A Novel Method for Limited Clinical Samples
central_results: 三种液体检测平台的RET重排检出比例相近但分母因失败样本不同，且非盲人工复核缺乏统一阳性判定。
narrative_sequence: 先交代平台检出与失败分母，再用人工复核偏倚限制解释。
papers.negative_result_handling: 没有阴性对照，未把未评估的特异度写成阴性结果。
papers.omics_logic: ctDNA融合检测属于跨平台方法学比较。
papers.efficacy_logic: 不涉及治疗疗效。
papers.prognosis_logic: 不涉及预后。
claim_boundaries: 检出率不是灵敏度；人工复核偏倚和标准化不足必须保留。

papers.title: Characterization of Plasma Cell-Free DNA Variants as of Tumor or Clonal Hematopoiesis Origin in 16,812 Advanced Cancer Patients
central_results: 42.3%的患者至少有一个CH变异；在变异层面27.8%被判定为CH而非肿瘤来源。
narrative_sequence: 先报告患者层患病比例，再报告变异层来源重分类，强调分母切换。
papers.negative_result_handling: 没有正式阴性比较。
papers.omics_logic: 配对白细胞/血浆变异频率用于来源判定。
papers.efficacy_logic: 不涉及疗效。
papers.prognosis_logic: 不涉及预后。
claim_boundaries: 不得混淆患者比例与变异比例，也不得把分类规则视为绝对真值。

papers.title: Quantitative Protein Expression of Antibody-Drug Conjugate Targets in EGFR Mutated and Wild-type Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
central_results: ADC target proteins showed weak cross-target correlations and TROP2 expression did not clearly stratify survival.
narrative_sequence: Map expression by histology and genotype, quantify cross-target correlations, then test associations with TKI outcomes.
papers.negative_result_handling: Small significant and nonsignificant correlations are reported side by side; null survival analyses are explicit.
papers.omics_logic: IHC protein expression is direct tissue measurement but assay/scoring heterogeneity remains.
papers.efficacy_logic: No ADC-treated cohort was evaluated, so target abundance is not a treatment-response biomarker here.
papers.prognosis_logic: Survival analyses are prognostic within treated cohorts, not predictive of ADC benefit.
claim_boundaries: Retrospective tissue availability and multiple comparisons limit clinical translation.

papers.title: Randomized Phase III Study of EGFR Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor and Intercalated Platinum-Doublet Chemotherapy for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Harboring EGFR Mutation
central_results: 主要OS终点未证实优效，ITT中次要PFS终点有利于EGFR-TKI加交替化疗。
narrative_sequence: 先明确主要终点阴性，再报告次要终点效应与敏感性/亚组，而非用PFS重写试验结论。
papers.negative_result_handling: OS阴性被放在叙述层级首位。
papers.omics_logic: 无核心组学。
papers.efficacy_logic: 随机试验支持PFS效应，但总体成功解释受主要OS阴性约束。
papers.prognosis_logic: OS主要终点阴性；PFS是次要终点。
claim_boundaries: 正文Results对同一PFS报P=0.0003，而Figure 3A/图注报P=0.0058（HR/CI相同）；必须显式标注，不能静默择一。

papers.title: Ad-SGE-DKK3 Gene Therapy Overcomes Resistance to Immune Checkpoint Blockade in Pleural Mesothelioma
central_results: DKK3 gene therapy remodeled antitumor immunity in models and produced limited single-arm activity in 12 patients, without evidence that DKK3 directly generated neopeptide responses.
narrative_sequence: Move from immune and antigen-presentation experiments to a mechanistic null, then report the small clinical cohort.
papers.negative_result_handling: The absence of increased neopeptide burden constrains the proposed mechanism while leaving alternative immune mechanisms open.
papers.omics_logic: Multi-assay preclinical findings are integrated, but lack of DKK3-derived MHC-I peptides argues against a direct neopeptide mechanism.
papers.efficacy_logic: The 12-patient clinical series supports activity only and cannot demonstrate synergy with checkpoint blockade.
papers.prognosis_logic: Prognosis was not a central inferential aim.
claim_boundaries: Preclinical mechanisms and human activity are distinct evidence layers and should not be collapsed.

papers.title: Factors Associated with Disease Progression after Discontinuation of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors for Immune-Related Toxicity in Patients with Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
central_results: 更高连续TMB与停药后PFS改善相关但与OS不显著；停药前治疗时长和最佳反应在多变量模型中与停药后结局相关。

papers.omics_logic: TMB为探索性基因组指标。
papers.efficacy_logic: 不是随机停药或治疗时长比较。

claim_boundaries: 不能据此规定最短治疗时长或声称因果停药策略。

papers.title: Izalontamab (SI-B001), a Novel EGFRxHER3 Bispecific Antibody in Patients with Locally Advanced or Metastatic Epithelial Tumor: Results from First-in-Human Phase I/Ib Study
central_results: 57例可评估患者中ORR 4%、DCR 37%、中位PFS 1.9个月；各EGFR/HER3表达水平均见反应。

papers.title: ctDNA Clearance as an Early Indicator of Improved Clinical Outcomes in Advanced NSCLC Treated with TKI: Findings from an Aggregate Analysis of Eight Clinical Trials
central_results: Across eight trials, ctDNA clearance associated with better PFS and OS, whereas first RECIST assessment showed no apparent association.

papers.negative_result_handling: The RECIST null is directly contrasted with the ctDNA association without labeling trial-level surrogacy.
papers.omics_logic: Aggregated genomic monitoring harmonizes patient-level signals across studies but retains assay and schedule heterogeneity.
papers.efficacy_logic: Clearance is associated with outcome; it does not prove that changing therapy on clearance improves efficacy.
papers.prognosis_logic: The analysis supports individual-level prognostic association, not trial-level surrogate validity.
claim_boundaries: Pooling eight trials and differing sampling schedules limit causal and regulatory claims.

papers.title: Amplification of Extrachromosomal MYC Paralogs Shapes Immunosuppressive Tumor Microenvironment in Small Cell Lung Cancer
central_results: ecMYC-amplified SCLC displayed proliferative, spatially immune-excluded and immunosuppressive states, while HU failed to activate antigen-presentation programs in an ecMYC-negative line.
narrative_sequence: Characterize ecDNA, perturb replication stress, compare cell lines, then integrate spatial and transcriptional immune evidence.
papers.negative_result_handling: The cell-line-specific null is retained to show context dependence.
papers.omics_logic: RNA programs, spatial protein patterns and cell-state inference are complementary but not interchangeable direct measurements.
papers.efficacy_logic: No clinical treatment efficacy comparison was performed.
papers.prognosis_logic: Human tissue associations do not establish survival prediction.
claim_boundaries: Mechanistic claims are bounded to preclinical perturbations and associative human spatial data.

papers.title: Ionizing Radiation Enhances Prognostically Significant Cellular Immunity Programs in the Brain Metastasis Microenvironment

papers.title: Improving Anti-CTLA-4 Therapies through Peptide Masking and Fragment Crystallizable Non-fucosylation: Preclinical Characterization of Three Novel Antibodies

central_results: With a median follow-up of 47.1 months (95% CI 42.1-50.4), patients with EGFRAMP, compared to patients with EGFRNon-AMP, achieved similar ORR (88% vs 83%, p=0.23) (Figure 1A), but significantly shorter median PFS (11.6 vs 19.0 months, HR 1.77, 95% CI, 1.36-2.31, p<0.0001) (Figure 1B) and OS (34.0 vs 40.1 months, HR 1.40, 95% CI, 1.02-1.94, p=0.040) (Figure 1C).

At resistance, patients with baseline EGFRAMP (n=28), compared to patients with baseline EGFRNon-AMP (n=85), more likely showed MET alterations (all amplifications or tyrosine kinase domain mutations) (29% vs 12%, p=0.04), while showing no significant differences in the rates of other acquired molecular alterations such as KRAS mutations, secondary EGFR mutations, BRAF, ALK, or RET fusions (4% vs 18%, p=0.11), or histologic transformation into squamous cell lung cancer or small cell lung cancer (7% vs 11%, p=0.69) (Figure 4A).

papers.title: Intratumoral Immune Heterogeneity Drives Divergent Outcomes to PD-(L)1 Blockade in Lung Cancer
central_results: An RNA-based ITIH classifier stratified ICI-treated survival across cohorts, but a PD-L1-high subset contrast remained numerical and underpowered.

papers.negative_result_handling: Moderate class performance and nonsignificant PD-L1-stratified contrasts are retained alongside positive survival results.

papers.prognosis_logic: Most cross-cohort survival contrasts are prognostic associations in treated populations.
claim_boundaries: Retrospective cohorts, missing PD-L1, sampling depth and lack of external multiregion validation constrain clinical claims.

papers.title: Ceralasertib plus durvalumab in Ras mutant and Ras wild type advanced non-small cell lung cancer: Two cohorts of the phase II platform National Lung Matrix Trial
central_results: Importantly, the activation of KRAS G12V results in a significant increase in the proportion of cells with micronuclei induced by ceralasertib alone up to the 1 μM dose, demonstrating that the impact of ceralasertib and KRAS activation on micronuclei formation is at least additive.

Although all outcome measures numerically favour the KRAS mutant over the wild type patients, the credible intervals for PFS, OS, DCB rate and OR rate for both KRAS mutant and wild type cohorts overlap (Figure 5C).

A very limited number of genes are differentially expressed between KRAS mutation-alone and KRAS wild type LUAD, with only a single gene significantly up-regulated in KRAS mutant-alone cancers - RORC.

papers.title: Safety and Efficacy of Ceralasertib plus Olaparib for Advanced/Metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer in Three Molecular Strata: The Phase II VIOLETTE Study
central_results: Ceralasertib plus olaparib did not significantly improve the primary PFS endpoint in any molecular stratum, although ORR improved in non-HRR-mutant tumors.
narrative_sequence: Report early arm closure and futility, analyze PFS by molecular stratum, then contrast secondary ORR, safety and exploratory biomarkers.
papers.negative_result_handling: The positive non-HRRm ORR signal is explicitly subordinated to the negative PFS endpoint.
papers.omics_logic: Archival mutation strata and exploratory amplifications are genomic subgrouping variables, not validated predictive biomarkers.
papers.efficacy_logic: Randomization supports comparison, but the study stopped early and the positive result is a secondary endpoint.
papers.prognosis_logic: Primary PFS was negative; OS was immature and not reported.
claim_boundaries: Early termination, low enrollment in one stratum, suboptimal dosing and multiplicity limit subgroup inference.

papers.title: Drug-specific resistance mechanisms to RET inhibitors in RET fusion-positive NSCLC
central_results: Distinct secondary RET substitutions produced inhibitor-specific resistance profiles across two fusion contexts; the variants did not measurably increase baseline growth, and one patient switch was clinically concordant with the preclinical sensitivity pattern.
narrative_sequence: Nominate variants by unbiased screening, validate drug-specific sensitivity and mechanism in engineered models, test next-generation inhibitors, then close with bounded clinical concordance.
papers.negative_result_handling: The absence of a detectable growth-rate difference separates acquired drug resistance from baseline proliferative advantage; it does not negate the validated shift in inhibitor sensitivity or prove the absence of every fitness effect.
papers.omics_logic: Mutation screening and validation in KIF5B-RET and CCDC6-RET contexts define drug- and fusion-context-specific resistance; they do not estimate mutation prevalence in patients.
papers.efficacy_logic: A prolonged response after one inhibitor switch supports clinical concordance only; a single patient cannot establish comparative efficacy or a preferred treatment sequence.
papers.prognosis_logic: The study does not support an independent prognostic claim.
claim_boundaries: AlphaFold 3 conformations are structural hypotheses rather than direct binding measurements.
The clinical inhibitor-switch evidence is limited to one patient and cannot establish a sequencing standard.
Separate supplements were not supplied for this intake.
